notes.title: Cast Or Pass 0.12
notes.notes:
Call lightning has a thicker hitbox to make it more likely to hit the mage dragon when it is flying.  
Frostbite is up to 5 damage.  
Goop Spray now does 2 damage.

These are mostly changes to make the Mage Dragon fight feel more fair for Storm Wizard and less of a slog for Slime Wizard.  I think I eventually want to do something where if the Mage Dragon has a full hand of Goop, it will just take a massive chunk of damage and stagger itself to cut down on the time where it is just sitting there doing nothing.  I might also make it so that the Goop cards don't count towards the hand limit, but I am worried about how that could look visually, especially with upcoming changes to the hand appearance that I am working on.
--
I wanted to give a status update because it has been a year since the beta first came out which was my initial rough estimate on how long it would take for the full version.  I now have a more clear idea of what all is going to be included in the release version, which my new plan is to have out by the end of the year.

First off, I want to update the icons and the steam page.  I'm thinking about doing a little spell book type thing for the icon.  For the steam page, I think I want to have all of the wizards, or at least a bunch of them, appearing on the front page. I'll probably look into getting those changes my artists makes her versions of the cast.

Speaking of the cast, I think I am going to stick with just the 12 existing wizards for the release update.  I have other ideas that I would like to make eventually as a future update (don't worry, not paid DLC), but I don't want to overload my artist with work.

That being said, I do plan on having 3 boss characters available for the boss battle mode.  I'm pretty happy with the way the Mage Dragon works with staggering and attack sequences.  The flying mechanic is probably going to be unique to the Mage Dragon though, with the other two bosses having different conditions for staggering them.

On top of the boss game mode, I would like to have a dungeon game mode.  I don't want to go too heavy into the details on that, but my intent would be to have the player explore a dungeon gathering treasures and spells by fighting enemies with the end goal of fighting one of the boss characters.  I have a bunch of ideas for this, but I do want to keep expectations low because it does seem like a big undertaking, and I do want to get the game to a complete and polished state, without getting caught up in all the possibilities of things that I could add.

One last thing I want to touch on is achievements.  I will probably add these when the full version of the game is ready.  I did want to put something to acknowledge people's achievements in beating the Mage Dragon, but it's still prone to changes so I don't want to end up giving out an achievement for beating a different version of the boss than the official version.
--
Sorry for the small update this time.  I was hoping to have something a bit more substantial, but my computer ended up dying and I had to get a new one.  My new computer has a 16:10 monitor though it seems, so hopefully it will be easier for me to debug the aspect ratio problem that has been tormenting me the entire time

I think I finally fixed the bug where mage dragon would just spam a bunch of flying spells all at once.  I believe it was initiated by the dragon being interrupted before finishing his takeoff sequence.  He would cast the spell the next time he finished the takeoff sequence.
--
I added indicators to robo wizards shield generator and doom core to make it way easier to time you casts
--
Focus potion and stoneskin potion were massively buffed from 2x to 3x and from 8 seconds to 10 seconds.
--
Potion components cast faster .2 instead of .3 seconds

notes.title: Cast or Pass 0.11
notes.notes:
Mage Dragon Boss Battle

I've been working on this mode for a while and I think I have gotten to a point where it at least has good and fun fundamentals, though I do expect to make more changes.  Here is a little explanation on how boss battles work.

Bosses can have hand sizes bigger than 2 (currently, the Mage Dragon has a hand size of 3).  Bosses play all cards in their hand in sequence.

Certain cards will "expose" a boss.  When the boss is hit while exposed, they will stagger, forcing them to discard their hand and take double damage for a brief duration.  Many of the bosses cards may be unblockable and require using a stagger to prevent damage.

The Mage Dragon will expose itself on it's flying attacks and it's lightning breath attack.
--
There are still some bugs that I haven't really been able to pin down, but they don't always show up so I want to get the mode out so I can start getting some feedback on difficulty and entertainment.  The hand arranger acts up sometimes stacking the cards on top of each other so you can't see the full play sequence.  Additionally, some times when the dragon gets staggered it will resume the play sequence, and will fly extra high if it plays another flying card.
--
Next month is almost certainly gonna have to be dedicated to quality of life and bug fixes.  I think there are a lot of lingering issues from the rework I did in the 0.10 update, and some things I just always needed to change.  I'll probably have balance updates to the Mage Dragon as well.  I might push out smaller updates throughout the month as I fix things up, then just set an event for the end of the month recapping all the changes.

notes.title: Cast Or Pass 0.10
notes.notes:
Did some reworks to some systems.  
Cards now all have both a pre cast and post cast time.  Cast speed does effect both of these, but I might have it not effect post cast time in future patches.  By default, I just set the post cast time to .2 seconds.  I want to eventually have separate animations for the precast and the post cast, but those are a while off.

Character select now has a grid of characters to choose from rather than just scrolling through a list.  This is just more in line with how other fighting games do their character select screens.  This isn't a final version, but it should be scalable so when I do eventually rework the character select screen I won't have to make coding changes, just UI layout changes.

Health is now a float value.  I have a fondness for trying to generate extra value out of rounding.  I don't think it belonged in this game.  Health will appear as a int still, but the visible value will just be the float value of the health rounded up.  I thought about just multiplying all the numbers by 10 so I could still have a bit of rounding, but I think this is the best way of doing it.
--
I had hoped to get the boss battle mode out, but honestly, it's not very good right now.  I wanted to have the Dragon form of Half-Dragon be the first boss, but I think that was limiting me too much in the design space for the boss itself.  I'm gonna go in a new direction for the boss battles, and that will probably continue to take precedence over new characters for the upcoming patches.

The Human form has a built in Curse, that makes them weaker than most wizards.
The Human form uses scorching ray to inflict burn on the opponent to deter attacks while trying to complete the Draconic Ritual which transforms them into their dragon form for a short duration.
The Dragon form has increased health and an array of incredibly powerful cards focused on overwhelming the opponent with offensive force.

4x Shield

Dragon Deck List:

2x Fireball
1x Firebreath
1x Meteor Swarm
2x Impenetrable Scales
1x Retain
2x Thundering Roar

notes.notes: Okay, I figured out why Portal Mage wasn't going through the jump on build even though he was in editor.  I had a custom shader to make him disappear through the portal, but you have to specifically include custom shaders in the build, even though unity will auto detect them in editor.  He should be jumping properly now.  As a bonus I fixed the bug were the arcane herb buff was just appearing in the middle of the screen instead of on the caster.

Hippie Wizard can smoke the Arcane Herbs in his Wizard Pipe to increase his damage and durability, but if the effect wears off, his he gets hung over and gets reduced cast speed.
Hippie Wizard utilizes his increased power to cast the powerful Doom Ball spell.
Hippie Wizard uses Goop Splash to status the opponent, making it harder to block the Doom Balls.

2x Doom Ball
1x Fireball
1x Goop Splash

1x Overload

Library updates.

You can now view related cards in the library.  For example, if you hover over Conjure Herb, you can navigate to the right to see Arcane Herb, the card that it summons.  This is especially useful for ritual cards like Brew Potions.  There is gonna be a new ritual card in the next patch, so there is that to look forward to.

notes.title: Cast or Pass 0.5
notes.notes:
New character added: Zombie Wizard.

Zombie Wizard has no shields.  Instead it relies on the life stealing power of Vampiric Drain.
Zombie Wizard can power up its Vampiric Drains by using Enrage.
Zombie Wizard can trigger Enrage on it's own using Infection.
Zombie Wizard features the new spell, Rampage, which is lost on pass, but has scaling damage based on the caster's missing health.

Full Deck List:
2x Blood Bolt
3x Enrage
4x Infection
1x Retain
3x Vampiric Drain
---
New Mode added: 2v2.

You can team up with your friend to duel now.  When you start casting a spell, you will move to the front of the team, forcing yourself to be vulnerable if you want to cast.  Coordinate with your friend as if you cast while they are channeling a spell, there is a good chance they will hit you in the back accidentally.

Try out combinations to cover for each others weaknesses, or double down on your characters strengths.  A defensive character like Slime Wizard can inflict the opponent with status conditions to allow Zombie Wizard opportunities to use it's high power but life costing spells more reliably.  An encroaching set of Doomballs from the Overlord can be even more overwhelming when paired with a spree of Arcane Echoes coming from the Explorer.

2v2 is a new mode and has some known bugs and issues.  
Storm Wizard is kind of broken and will always target the same character with Call Lightning even if they are defeated.  
The Tavern is also not set up for 2v2 mode and is disabled this patch.  It will come back though.
The UI was not setup with 2v2 in mind and is a little crowded.  I plan on doing an overhaul, but for now, just remember that even as your character changes positions, your cards won't.
---
New Map added: The Graveyard

I hyped it up a bit, but honestly, it is just a reskin of the woods.  Fun for some Halloween themed dueling.  I do plan on having more diversity in the maps with experimenting with different spacing, as well as hazards.

notes.title: Cast Or Pass 0.4

New character added: Alchemist.

Alchemist brews potions with the new spell Brew Potions.
Brew Potions is a new type of card called ritual cards, that will add temporary components to the deck.  Get pair of potions depending on the 2 ingredients you choose.
Alchemist can use frostbite to cut the opponent's cast speed to allow you to brew more safely.

Full Deck List:
1x Brew Potions
1x Fireball
1x Frostbite
1x Retain
3x Shield
---
I reworked the input system to use Unity's new input system.  Hopefully this fixes some of the hard to track controller bugs that seemed to not be consistent across devices.  Haven't tested if it broke steam remote play, but I don't think it should have.  I also fixed up the menu a bit to use screen space rather than pixels, which hopefully fixes the visual bug where they buttons didn't line up well with the tower.  Clicking the buttons is fixed too, I think.  Lastly you can now use any input for the tutorial, depending on what control scheme you opened the tutorial with.
---
Alchemist is the first piece of art from my new artist!  She is pretty busy with college apps right now, so I had to do all the animations still (so don't blame her if they are still kind of weak), but I am very excited to have her talent on the team.  Next month I plan to get one more character out, then I am going to focus on game modes until she can get caught up a bit updating some of the old art so we can have a more unified (and appealing) art style.
---
Lastly wanted to wish everyone a happy Halloween this month.  Hope you all have some fun battles with our resident snow vampire, Cold Blooded Caster, and our new witchy potion brewer, Alchemist.  I'll have one more Halloween appropriate character coming out in the 0.5 update, so I might release it a day early so it comes out on Halloween itself.  Happy spooky times!
